eventDetail.scope: ICNDEMAC is an international research conference that aims to promote knowledge in the fields of electronics, communications, and related cutting-edge technologies. The conference is centered on original research contributions in the fields of nano-materials for advanced devices, nano-electronics, communication networks, AI-based signal and image processing. The conference is a platform for academicians, researchers, and professionals to share new research findings, exchange ideas, and promote collaboration that leads to innovation in the theoretical and practical domains of modern electronic and communication engineering.
